title: Why the Webb band was his best training
summary: He says working with Webb let him walk through other bands, thanks to earlier study and rubbing elbows with giants.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Then the Chick Webb Band was --

I think that that was the greatest experience I had, because all the other bands that came out of that, was just to see if you can do this, you know. "Yeah, well send get to Teddy, he can do it," you know. And everybody's hoping, (inaudible). But I walked through those bands because I had the experience to walk through them. I studied a lot when I was young. I came up with my brothers. When I really got in a chance to really use it was when I came in with all these giants -- down there with Small's and with Benny -- working around with Coleman.
